summary: Card Thief is a solitaire-style stealth card game.
description:
Card Thief is a solitaire-style stealth card game that transforms your deck into a shadowy world of cunning heists and daring escapes.

Sneak through the darkness as a master thief. Extinguish torches, pickpocket guards, and steal precious treasure without getting caught. Every card you flip is a calculated risk. Every move could be your last.

From the makers of Card Crawl, the hit indie card dungeon crawler, Card Thief distills the tension of classic stealth games into a sleek, strategic card game you can play in minutes. Easy to learn, endlessly deep.

Plan. Steal. Escape. Repeat.

With a rich layer of tactical decision-making, risk/reward choices, and roguelike replayability, Card Thief is the perfect pick-up-and-play strategy card game for fans of stealth, puzzle games, and solo card games alike.

Features

- Solitaire-style stealth gameplay with no internet required
- 4 unique heists with distinct enemies, traps, and obstacles
- 12 unlockable and upgradable equipment cards with unique abilities
- Hire 10 thieves, each with special gameplay rules
- Mini deck-building mechanics for deep strategic customization
- Daily Heist mode with global leaderboards
- Roguelike replayability so every run plays differently
- Perfect session length of 2 to 3 minutes per game
- Offline play, great for travel
